title: Containment
description: A Novice's warding experiment tore loose in the Athenaeum basement less than an hour ago. Two archivists were dragged out with their arms scorched black before anyone got the stairwell sealed, and the tear they left behind is still widening. A dozen more of the Circle's own are working the stacks directly above it. Get down there and close it before it reaches the floor they're standing on.

objectives.description: Get down to the basement before the tear reaches the stairs
Force the corrupted ley node back into shape before it burns anyone else
objectives.notes: Requires channeling magic to dispel corruption

objectives.description: Cut down what the corruption spat out before it reaches the stacks above
objectives.notes: Hostile magical entities attacking the Athenaeum

objectives.description: Close the breach while it's still small enough to close
objectives.notes: Use containment ritual to close the tear

objectives.description: Tell Elara what it took to hold the line, and who got burned doing it

notes: Threat: two archivists already burned, breach still widening under a floor a dozen more Circle members are working. Giver motive: a public disaster inside the Athenaeum, with the Circle's own hurt by it, is exactly the story Elara's rivals on the council want to tell about her stewardship. Consequence: the two archivists' injuries are named and permanent on the page; stopping the tear now is what keeps it from becoming a dozen more. No mechanical clock is wired - the urgency lives in the prose only. Second Journeyman quest. PREREQUISITE FIX: the value in `prerequisites` was a FLAG name, not a quest id - QuestManager reads that list as completed QUEST ids, so this quest was never available and the ladder was dead from mage_02 down. Moved to `flag_prerequisites`, which is the list of flags that is actually checked; the flag itself is raised by the previous quest's on_complete_flags.
